title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 18-Inch Iron Straight Bar, Pipeline Collection Bathroom Hardware | Spanish Gold | Allied Brass
description:
Add dependable towel storage with this 18-Inch wall mount towel bar from the Pipeline collection in Spanish Gold, which presents a rich, warm golden tone with European-inspired elegance, bringing luxury and sophistication to distinguished bathrooms. The straight bar delivers an industrial, pipe-fitting look that pairs well with transitional bathroom hardware and other versatile bath accessories, while keeping towels within easy reach.

Highlights:
- Spanish Gold elevates the room with luxe gold tones
- Choose from 19 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Wall mount towel bar helps save floor space in the bathroom
- Includes towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware (color-coordinated)
- Limited Lifetime Warranty

Specs:
- Center-to-center: 18 inches
- Overall length: 18 inches
- Bar diameter: 0.75 inch
- Projection: 3.3 inches
- Dimensions: 18 in L x 3 in H x 3.3 in W
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Assembly required: No
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4"
